answer: Stake plus costly randomness works. An agent posting a bond locks real value, so spawning a thousand puppets means funding a thousand bonds. Registration also requires solving a per-epoch challenge derived from orbital noise, like a nebula's flickering dust, which wears down scripted farms. New identities must earn attestations from independent peers on a common jetty of verified work before they may vouch for anyone. A rare signed quartz token anchors reputation so clones cannot recycle it.
